LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

description:
A group of texts sharing the translation key prefix ``<id>.realmforge.``, for example ``key`` for key
mapping names (``key.realmforge.night_vision``) or ``message`` for chat and action bar messages.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case words joined by dots; the key prefix. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

texts.description: Text name (lowercase snake_case) -> text; the key is <id>.realmforge.<name>.
texts.title: Texts
